commits.message: fix(colour): keep hue turns distinct at every supported depth

fix(audits): theme-identity no longer asserts the seam ΔE floor the joiner rule deleted (candybar-later-fixes-nwu9.ic0)

Its second fact failed every seam whose two grounds sit under
SEAM_MIN_DELTA_E, the floor candybar-joiners-e5r4 replaced with identity
after rounding. The seam sweep now holds that rule over the same looks, so
the fact and its private seam reader go; the palette fact stays.

test(audits): the seam sweep holds the joiner rule under every look, closed and hot and calm (candybar-later-fixes-nwu9.ic0)

The sweep takes a scope (looks, views, depths, payloads) instead of one
variation at today's dial, unstyled, on the sample payload. Its exemptions
are computed on the palette the bar wears, transposed through rich-js by
the look's style. A payload names which listed cells it puts on alert, and
a calmed cell must wear its tint and is held. Any divider fails.

The audit keeps its frame case and adds the case the theme-identity seam
fact walked: every variation x dial position x style, the closed bar, hot
and calm, at truecolor.
test(follow): cover the window lane in the native client

feat(lanes): a window lane hands off the statusline and is pushed the Frame, whose links its follower clicks (candybar-bar-window-hpro.akk)

The window lane (🧪 window (D), `experimentalWindow`) replaces Claude Code's
statusline the way the tmux pane does: while a window follower is attached,
the statusline answers the one-row handoff, and its `[⟲ claude]` button turns
the lane off, ending the follower's subscription SWITCHED_OFF.

Each lane names its feed encoding in the lane table: the statusline the ANSI,
the pane the ANSI with its hit map, the window the Frame, whose runs carry
their signed links. Pointer ownership is derived from the encoding, so the
window may own the session's pointer as the pane does; the pointer now rides
on the session's viewers rather than on one lane.

Along the way: the protocol check's lane-table anchor reads the table's new
`satisfies` clause, and a watcher test that wrote once before its watch was
live now proves the watch live first.

fix(url-handler): one place says where a click's copy and open act, and the app routes by one route (candybar-ssh-links-16rz.6oi)

Review pass 1 of #968: the fact that a copy or open acts on the desktop was spelled in a delivery arm, an optional flag, a predicate and a synthetic arrival; it is now one required actsOn on the act and on the forwarder, read in one place. The app's decisions on routing and verdicts move into wire.swift with expectations; the verdict is one enum.

feat(url-handler): copy and open links clicked over ssh act on the Mac (candybar-ssh-links-16rz.6oi)

A click that reaches the daemon down an ssh forward now asks for its copy and open acts to come back in the verdict, and the Mac's app carries them out: text on the Mac's clipboard, and the remote path opened in an editor over ssh. The host leaves exactly the acts stamped for the click's writer, so a click parked for its config is decided like any other. A daemon older than the app, an editor with no host name, and a refusing pasteboard are each told on the Mac. ssh-config now takes the host alias and writes it once, into the forward's file name.

## [1.238.4](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.238.3...v1.238.4) (2026-11-25)

### Bug Fixes

* **url-handler:** route a click on a bar drawn over ssh to the daemon that drew it ([#963](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/963)) ([5877b61](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/5877b610c5add94bfeec9ef566be3e309841d7ec))

feat(settings-menu): the menu leads with 🎨 look and 📚 saves & presets, and the lane switches live under 📺 renderer (brandon-menus-sjhy.88j)

The first line now reads ✖ ◁ 🎨 look 📚 saves & presets ✎ arrange; the strip
under it holds ⚡ session and ⚙ config, and one tab is open at a time across
both lines. 🎨 look lays its controls in rows: theme with its ⚙ and endcaps,
then effect and speed, then fade in/out. 📚 saves & presets holds the preset
picker and + preset. The 📐 layout tab and the 🧪 toggles submenu are gone;
⚙ config's 📺 renderer holds both lane switches.

A tab names the line its trigger leads from and a control the line of its
place it sits on, so where things draw stays data. No setting sits on the
first line itself any more, so that place is gone from the type.

fix(transcript): the loss vocabulary sits below the fold and the document, a message's usage with no count is no usage, and a loss is logged once however it grows (candybar-later-fixes-nwu9.3fy)

fix(transcript): a sidechain the fold cannot read fails the refresh, and a line is parsed into its entry or dropped with why (candybar-later-fixes-nwu9.3fy)

Law-review pass 1 on #960.

- A sidechains directory that cannot be listed, or a new sidechain whose
  first line cannot be read, fails the refold through its one failed arm,
  so nothing short is stored and the next render retries. A loss is only
  what a read that succeeded could not use: a dropped line, or a sidechain
  whose first line (blank, not JSON, naming no session) cannot say whose
  it is.
- The entry parse parses: a timestamp that is not a date, usage with no
  timestamp, or usage counts that are not numbers drop the line with its
  reason. A projection that throws is the daemon's fault, not a dropped line.
- A drop names its line number, which the cursor counts, so it is exact
  across windows and bytes that are not UTF-8.
- The window parse returns its drops as data, and a reset replaces the
  fold in one step.
- Losses are derived once at refold, stored on the record, and logged once
  when first met. A sidechain gone after the listing is out of the session,
  as one gone before it.
- The facts document carries its stamp failure and its transcript losses as
  their own fields. The lane diagnostics, a copy of each lane's failed
  reading that nothing drew, are gone. FACTS_VERSION 6.
- The cache timer reads its lines through the one line reading.
- templateHelperRefs and the comments naming the deleted unused check are
  gone; the real lister's test covers the paths rotation removes; the
  harness copies left in tests share one helper each.

fix(transcript): a transcript line or sidechain the fold cannot read shows as ⚠ on the session's bar (candybar-later-fixes-nwu9.3fy)

A line that is not JSON, or whose entry cannot be projected, used to be
dropped with only a debug-log line, and so did a sidechain whose read
failed, whose first line was not JSON, or whose directory could not be
listed. Each left the session's usage and cost short with nothing on the
bar to say so.

The fold now keeps what it dropped (how many lines, where the first
starts, why) beside its cursor, so the loss lasts exactly as long as the
numbers it is missing from and goes when a rewrite re-folds the file. The
usage store reports each file's losses and each unread sidechain into the
session's facts diagnostics, and the bar draws one standing warning per
file, with the viewer naming the file and the reason.

Tests share one in-process main-renderer harness instead of two copies.
